sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; i bigint; BEGIN OPEN curs2; FETCH NEXT FROM curs2 INTO i; MOVE ABSOLUTE 1 FROM curs2; FETCH curs2 INTO i; CLOSE curs2; END $$;
note: mix FETCH NEXT then MOVE ABSOLUTE then FETCH

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs1 refcursor; r record; tabname text := 't'; BEGIN OPEN curs1 FOR EXECUTE format('SELECT id, name FROM s.%I', tabname); FETCH curs1 INTO r; CLOSE curs1; END $$;
note: OPEN FOR EXECUTE using format with %I identifier quoting

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs1 refcursor; r record; BEGIN OPEN curs1 FOR EXECUTE $q$SELECT id FROM s.t$q$; FETCH curs1 INTO r; CLOSE curs1; END $$;
note: OPEN FOR EXECUTE with dollar-quoted string literal

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; r record; BEGIN FOR r IN curs2 LOOP RAISE NOTICE 'id=%', r.id; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOR cursor LOOP with RAISE NOTICE inside body

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs1 refcursor; r record; BEGIN OPEN curs1 FOR SELECT * FROM s.rows_f(); FETCH curs1 INTO r; CLOSE curs1; END $$;
note: cursor opened on set-returning function (fixture s.rows_f)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; i bigint; BEGIN OPEN curs2; FETCH NEXT FROM curs2 INTO i, i; CLOSE curs2; END $$;
note: FETCH INTO more targets than columns: extra targets allowed (PG assigns NULL to extra)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 NO SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; i bigint; BEGIN OPEN curs2; FETCH PRIOR FROM curs2 INTO i; CLOSE curs2; END $$;
note: FETCH PRIOR from NO SCROLL cursor (scrolling not allowed)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; i bigint; BEGIN OPEN curs2; FETCH 1 FROM curs2 INTO i; CLOSE curs2; END $$;
note: FETCH count without direction keyword (syntax error)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t; i bigint; BEGIN OPEN curs2; FETCH ABSOLUTE FROM curs2 INTO i; CLOSE curs2; END $$;
note: FETCH ABSOLUTE without count argument (syntax error)
